headline: Kyiv Independent: Ukraine asks EU to cover a 70 billion euro budget deficit for 2027, ahead of European elections
summary: Ukraine's prime minister asked the EU to set a clear plan by end-2026 to cover an estimated 70 billion euro budget deficit for 2027. He warned that elections in several member states next year could complicate support.
why: Ukraine depends heavily on external financing from the EU and international partners to fund its budget and wartime spending.
